PDF.js 6.3.289, Mozilla and individual contributors.
Downloaded from the official pdfjs-dist npm package.
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Apache License 2.0: see LICENSE.

Bundled here so the document reader makes no third-party CDN requests.
The core module, worker module, CMaps, standard fonts and WebAssembly decoders
are unmodified distribution files. Ancillary font and decoder licenses are
included in their respective directories.
